jobs.title: Electrical Engineer Intern (EE, RF, FPGA disciplines) - Phoenix Site
jobs.description_text: Acron Aviation is seeking motivated and innovative Electrical Engineering interns to join our engineering teams in Phoenix, Arizona. This full-time, onsite internship is anticipated to run May through August and provides an opportunity to apply classroom knowledge in a professional engineering environment. Interns will contribute to the design, development, testing, integration, and support of aviation products and technologies. Depending on the assigned location, team, and product line, interns may gain experience across electrical engineering disciplines such as analog, digital, power, radio frequency, high-speed circuitry, embedded systems, firmware, programmable logic, circuit card assemblies, and supporting cables or interfaces. You will work alongside experienced engineers and collaborate with cross-functional teams while developing your technical, analytical, and professional skills.

jobs.title: Embedded Hardware Engineer - Electro Optical Systems
jobs.description_text: About Trakka Systems Trakka Systems is a global leader in the design, development, and manufacture of mission-critical vision, surveillance, and situational awareness solutions for airborne, maritime, and land-based operations. For more than 25 years, Trakka has delivered innovative technologies including advanced gyro-stabilized imaging systems, EO/IR sensor platforms, high-intensity searchlights, mission management and mapping software, counter-UAS solutions, and integrated surveillance systems that support defense, law enforcement, border security, search and rescue, utility, and special mission operators around the world. Trakka Systems is a member of the Acron Technologies platform of specialized companies that innovate to create safer skies and protect lives. Trakka Systems is seeking a hands-on Embedded Hardware Engineer to design, develop, and debug the electronics inside our airborne, land, and maritime electro-optical products. This is a bench-forward design role: you will own circuit boards from concept through schematic capture, layout, bring-up, and qualification — including real-time video processing, motor control and stabilization, serial communications, and DC/DC power regulation. Alongside new development, you will serve as the hardware escalation point for our production and field service teams, applying the same instrumentation and root-cause discipline to units already in the field. jobs.title: Embedded Software Lead Engineer
jobs.description_text: About Acron Aviation (Avionics – Surveillance): Acron Aviation designs, engineers, and manufactures certified avionics systems that support safety-critical flight operations across commercial and military aviation. Within Avionics, the Surveillance product line develops and sustains systems that enable aircraft awareness, collision avoidance, and airspace interoperability. Our portfolio includes TCAS, Mode S transponders, ADS-B, and integrated surveillance solutions deployed across commercial, military, and rotorcraft platforms. This work is performed in highly regulated environments and demands deep expertise across systems, hardware, software, and RF throughout the full product lifecycle. As an Embedded Software Lead Engineer, you will serve as the primary software subject matter expert for Acron Aviation's Lynx surveillance product family. This role is focused on technical leadership, product knowledge, and software lifecycle ownership rather than direct people management. You will provide guidance and oversight for software development, integration, verification, certification, sustainment, and customer support activities while helping preserve and expand critical Lynx product knowledge within the organization. The successful candidate will work closely with Systems Engineering, Hardware Engineering, Verification, Program Management, and customer-facing teams to ensure the continued success and evolution of Lynx products and related surveillance technologies.

INVESTIGATE guides evidence synthesis, timeline development, multi-threaded causal analysis, and corrective actions. Customers have reported an 80% reduction in root cause analysis labor time using Haven. jobs.description_text:
Who We Are

Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management. 

We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), a $5.8B valuation, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Connected Warfare division builds systems to support and execute global command and control missions. We create joint, time sensitive, multi domain, ubiquitous, connected mesh ecosystems. Our ecosystem enables connected warfare with disproportional impact by connecting every robot, human, and sensor in every domain, aggregating together hundreds of thousands of end points across the globe for battlefield dominance. We are the substrate that provides the source of truth for critical commander decision-making, effectively transforming the way that militaries close kills chains and enable mission autonomy.
